Examples: Design Decisions 'Suite placement for the orchestration-event trace splits across two existing suites' justifies TEST-018/TEST-019 ownership by citing decision doc §3.1 and existing suite scope (INV-005); 'capability_applicability starts on quality-gate only, not every entry' justifies the scoping decision by citing decision doc §3.1 and WFI-011 evidence-citation discipline; 'F7/F8 ... are N/A, not SKIP' justifies the disposition choice against ADR-0016 Decision item 2; the two-command golden-baseline contract ('never one script with a mutation flag') is justified against Security Boundaries B1's CI-write-protection goal; frontend-spec.md's Technology Stack table gives an explicit Rationale cell for every row. No inline decision was found stated as a bare 'we will use X' without a because/since-grounded justification.

A targeted grep for response-time/throughput/concurrency/latency/SLA/numeric-ms-threshold language across requirements.md returned no matches; this is a Phase 1 test-infrastructure specification package (design.md Feature Type: 'test-infrastructure specification (Phase 1 - no code)') with no stated SLA or latency target for any future-task deliverable.

design.md's ## External Integrations section states 'None. Every target in this package is internal to the repository (existing scripts, schemas, templates, and the future golden baseline)', consistent with investigation.md INV-017 (grep confirms no capability-machinery code exists anywhere in this worktree) and with the Components/Global Constraints tables, which list only existing internal repository files (loop-inventory.json, loop-driver.sh, loop-consistency/loop-escalation suites, emit-run-record.sh, install/uninstall suites, contracts/*.schema.json, sdd-bootstrap-interviewer templates) as touch points. No external system, third-party service, or cross-service API call is referenced anywhere in design.md, security-spec.md, or infra-spec.md ('No cloud, no region, no network boundary').

Every design.md Component maps 1:1 to a requirements.md REQ: loop-inventory.json/loop-driver.sh/loop-escalation.tests.sh/loop-consistency.tests.sh/emit-run-record.sh extensions to REQ-003; install/uninstall suite extensions to REQ-001; golden-baseline capture/promote scripts to REQ-006; the fixture-matrix builder to REQ-005; the compatibility-event-trace schema to REQ-003; the REQ-007 SKIP allowlist manifest to REQ-007 -- no component, data model, or API endpoint appears in design.md's Components table without a corresponding requirement. design.md's Cross-Layer Dependencies table traces every one of REQ-003/REQ-005/REQ-006/REQ-007 to at least one requirements.md AC, and design.md's Architecture diagram plus Compatibility Matrix (F1-F8) and nine-item Test Strategy jointly cover requirements.md's full REQ-001-REQ-007 Goals list and all three User Stories. No under- or over-scoped capability was found.

High-risk surfaces are present in this design (not skippable): the golden-baseline write-authorization boundary (Security Boundaries B1), the shared cross-epic registry/driver/run-record blast-radius boundary (B2), the REQ-007 SKIP-allowlist integrity boundary (B3), the cross-epic fingerprint-citation integrity boundary (B4), and the structural-comparison record-corpus tamper-resistance boundary (B5). Each has a concrete, named validation path: B1 -> AC-040 (static scan of .github/workflows/test.yml for the two mutation-capable command strings) and AC-041 (direct runtime-refusal integration fixture pair, CI-env-var-set and --approved-by-omitted); B2 -> AC-008/AC-009/AC-011/AC-033 (registration-forcing count check, unmodified-helper check, byte-identical no-flag output check, four-combination flag matrix with a golden negative test); B3 -> AC-034/AC-035 (three independently-hard-failing conditions: dependency-present SKIP, unknown SKIP, fingerprint drift) via Test Strategy item 8; B4 -> AC-035c's fingerprint_match recompute-and-compare evaluator; B5 -> AC-030's parser-failure-is-a-hard-fail discipline plus AC-031's separate non-gating live-model refresh path. All are cited by explicit AC/TEST ID and Test Strategy item number in design.md/security-spec.md/acceptance-tests.md.
